exposure: Blastocyst biopsy in preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
cohort: Live births after blastocyst biopsy combined with frozen ET (PGT group) and frozen blastocyst transfer after in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (control group)
finding: Blastocyst biopsy in PGT did not significantly increase the risk of adverse neonatal outcomes compared to the control group, except for a higher cesarean section rate in twins.
